access_key_read_only_label: Read-only — never mints a Key, changes a password or mints an Invite
access_key_secret_once: Copy this now — it is shown once and never again.
account_failed: That name and password do not match.
account_invite_blurb: This one-use Invite creates your account and Home Kitchen.
account_recover_blurb: This one-use recovery link is spent when you set your new password.
account_setup_blurb: The first person here becomes this kitchen's Operator.
cook_failed: Could not start cooking this recipe.
cook_false_start_confirm: Throw this cooking away? Starting counts as a cooking, so this is how a false start is undone.
cook_finished: Cooked. Add a rating or a note in the diary whenever you like.
cook_no_steps: This recipe has no steps to cook through.
cook_nothing_new: Nothing new to add — just the pot.
cooked_blurb: Every cooking you started, newest first — finished or not.
cooked_delete_confirm: Delete it? A cooking deleted is gone for good.
cooked_empty: Nothing cooked yet. Start cooking a recipe and it lands here, whether or not you ever finish it.
cooked_failed: The diary could not be read. Kamosu may be restarting.
cooked_gone: This recipe is no longer on your shelf.
divergence_leaving: leaving your recipe when you save
divergence_nothing_to_carry: Nothing to carry — this one is yours already.
divergence_put_away: Just the recipe. {count} differences put away.
divergence_said_added: {kitchen} wrote this after you parted. You haven’t got it.
divergence_said_removed: {kitchen} took this out. You still have it in yours.
divergence_said_yours_only: You wrote this after you parted. {kitchen} hasn’t got it.
divergence_save_hint: Written for you as a sentence, and yours to rewrite. Kamosu stores what you say happened, not a pointer at {kitchen}’s recipe.
divergence_saved: Saved. Those lines are part of your recipe now.
divergence_take_remove: Take it out of mine as well
divergence_too_many: This recipe has {count} Branches on this Kamosu. The switch reads two, so yours is shown on its own.
divergence_unsaved: {count} lines from {kitchen}, sitting on your recipe. Not saved.
divergence_unsaved_one: One line from {kitchen}, sitting on your recipe. Not saved.
divergence_unshared_one: One line you and {kitchen} don’t share
home_blurb: Four ways in, worked out from what you have.
home_empty: Nothing is cooking yet. What you start will wait for you here.
home_empty_why: Home is worked out from your own recipes and your own cooking, so it fills itself in as you go. Right now there is nothing to work from.
home_failed: Kamosu could not work out your shelves just now.
home_shelf_cooked_most_why: What you keep coming back to
kitchen_invite_secret_once: Copy this now — it is shown once and never again.
meaning_now_on: Meaning search is on. Try that search again.
meaning_what_it_costs: It needs {model}, which Kamosu does not ship. Turning it on downloads the model — about 220 MB — and means accepting Google's terms for it.
measures_explained: How much a line means for you, on one line beneath it. Kamosu never rewrites the recipe, always says about, and says nothing where the line is already in your measures. American is the default, as a stated convention: a cup is 240 ml, a tablespoon 15 ml, a teaspoon 5 ml.
reading_failed: That Reading could not be saved.
reading_no_version: The line above is untouched. Correcting a Reading is not an edit to the recipe and makes no Version.
recipe_failed: This recipe could not be read.
recipes_blurb: One shelf, and a result that says what matched.
recipes_empty: The shelf is empty. The first recipe you write or import lands here.
recipes_failed: The shelf could not be read. Kamosu may be restarting.
recipes_import_unreadable: That page holds no recipe Kamosu could read.
recipes_nothing_meaning: Meaning search finds a recipe when you describe it rather than name it.
recipes_nothing_why: Kamosu looked through every title, ingredient and step on your shelf, and your own cooking notes. Meaning search is off on this Kamosu, so it matched the words themselves.
recipes_nothing_why_meaning: Kamosu looked through every title, ingredient and step on your shelf, your own cooking notes, and what each recipe means — and nothing came close enough.
settings_meaning_catching_up: {count} recipes have changed since the index was last read. Kamosu catches up within the minute.
settings_meaning_declined: Off. You declined the model's terms, so Kamosu searches by words alone.
settings_meaning_off: Off. The model's terms are accepted, so turning it on needs no new agreement.
settings_meaning_on: On, using {model}. Searching matches on meaning as well as on words.
settings_operator_boundary: The Operator boundary is a courtesy, not a wall: whoever holds the disk holds everything.
share_address_hint: Where people reach this Kamosu from outside, e.g. https://kamosu.example.com. Asked once, and kept — a link is stored as a token, so changing the address later does not break a link already sent.
share_address_missing: A link needs an address people can open.
share_blurb: One permanent address, for anyone you send it to.
share_failed: The link could not be changed.
share_is_shared: Anyone with this link can read this recipe.
share_link_shown_once: Copy it now — Kamosu keeps only a fingerprint of this link and cannot show it to you again. Ending the link and turning it back on mints a new one.
share_not_shared: This recipe has no link. Only your Kitchen can see it.
share_standing: A share carries everything this recipe has ever been, back to its first version — every name and every note about what changed. Ending the link stops anyone new from opening it. It cannot reach a copy already sent.
shopping_blurb: A choice of recipes, not a list of things.
shopping_empty: No list yet. Choose the recipes you mean to cook and Kamosu writes one.
thread_blurb: Every save is a Version, in order. Nothing here is ever rewritten.
thread_cooking_failed: Could not start cooking this Version.
thread_cooking_started: Started — this Attempt is pinned to this Version.
thread_failed: The Thread could not be read.
thread_fork_detail: Kamosu worked this out by walking each Branch's chain back until they met — this is the last Version they share.
tokens_blurb: Every value below is read from the stylesheet this page loaded. Nothing here is maintained by hand.
tokens_specimen: The quick brown fox · Le renard brun saute par-dessus le chien paresseux
